custody: generated only after every model, rule and metric of the confirmatory analysis is frozen; disjoint from BD_GEN_V1, the 34 exposed test roots and the pilot namespace; pilot roots never enter it
pilot_evidence_used: construction feasibility, rejection rate, verified-K realization and teacher cost only (no model was run on a pilot root)
precision: with n_inf initially infeasible roots, a paired difference of corrective success has 95 % half-width <= 1.96 * 0.5 / sqrt(n_inf) (worst case): n_inf = 150 -> 0.080, 200 -> 0.069
stop_rule: fixed root count; no interim look at labels or model outputs
waves: wave 1..; a rejected slot is retried with wave + 1 for the same slot up to 5 times, every attempt recorded; the slot is dropped (not replaced by a different spec) after 5 rejections
